'''Kortawa the Hunt Master''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] until [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kortawa appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on Tatooine. He can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
